# polaris_semantic_model (Data Source)

Read an existing Polaris semantic_model without granting access or persisting vended credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_semantic_model" "example" {
  catalog   = "warehouse"
  namespace = ["sales"]
  name      = "chosen"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) Containing catalog.
- `name` (String) Stable object name. Import existing names before applying.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace path components; dots remain literal.

### Read-Only

- `document_json` (String) Ossie document object with version and semantic_model (a JSON object serialized as a string).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `metadata_json` (String, Sensitive) Current object metadata, excluding response credential-vending configuration.
